question: New Rihanna Album before GTA VI?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Rihanna officially releases a new album before Grand Theft Auto VI is officially released in the US. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If neither occurs by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

For the purposes of this market, "release" refers to the game becoming publicly available for purchase or download in the US. Early access, beta versions, other forms of pre-release availability, or leaks will not count as an official release. If the release is only for certain consoles (e.g. Xbox Series X/S) it will count.

The resolution source for the release of GTA VI is official information from Rockstar Games or its parent company, Take-Two Interactive.

Officially released means that a newly released album is officially available for download or streaming (not including live events) by the resolution date.

Re-releases, deluxe editions, compilations, or greatest hits albums will not count, unless they contain at least 50% tracks that have never been officially released in any format prior to the album's release.

The resolution source for the album release will be any official streaming or download site, e.g. Apple Music or Spotify.

events.title: What will happen before GTA VI?
events.description: This is a market on predicting events that will occur before the release of Grand Theft Auto VI.

eventMetadata.context_description: GTA VI's confirmed November 19, 2026 release date sets a fixed five-month window that shapes all trader positions on preceding events. Rockstar's November 2025 delay announcement and Take-Two's summer 2026 marketing ramp-up, including expected Trailer 3 and pre-order timing around late June, have sharpened focus on near-term catalysts. Markets currently price high-probability outcomes like a Russia-Ukraine ceasefire or specific music drops such as a new Playboi Carti album or Drake's Iceman project, reflecting real capital consensus on timelines. Upcoming chart updates, streaming milestones, and any official Rockstar communications could quickly shift implied probabilities, while the game's console-only launch and industry-wide schedule ripple effects add layers of uncertainty for entertainment-related resolutions.

question: Will Harvey Weinstein be sentenced to no prison time?
description:
This market will resolve according to the prison sentence, if any, imposed on Harvey Weinstein as part of his ongoing New York retrial (People of the State of New York v. Harvey Weinstein) by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

This market will resolve immediately based on the first sentence rendered in this case, regardless of any appeals. If Weinstein is found not guilty, there is a mistrial, or if the first sentencing does not include any jail or prison time, this market will resolve to "No Prison Time."

If no sentencing takes place by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will also resolve to "No Prison Time."

If the sentence falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

For the purposes of this market, it does not matter whether the sentence is concurrent or consecutive to any existing sentence Weinstein is already serving. The market will resolve based on the total prison sentence imposed in this case.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the New York court system or other involved U.S. government sources; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: **The dominant market consensus favoring no additional prison time stems primarily from the May 15, 2026 mistrial in Harvey Weinstein’s third New York rape trial on the Jessica Mann charge, where the jury deadlocked after just days of deliberation (with reports indicating nine of twelve jurors leaned toward acquittal).** Prosecutors have until late June to decide on a potential fourth trial, but repeated hung juries and evidentiary challenges have eroded momentum for further conviction. Weinstein, already serving consecutive sentences including a 16-year Los Angeles term that likely ensures lifelong incarceration, faces mounting health complications at age 74 while held at Rikers Island. Traders view these factors—combined with the #MeToo-era case’s procedural fatigue and his existing custodial status—as sharply limiting any realistic prospect of meaningful added time from the unresolved Manhattan count.

question: Will the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This market will resolve to “No” if it becomes impossible for this team to win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup based off the rules of the NHL.

The resolution source for this market will be information from the NHL.

events.title: 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Champion
events.description: This market is to predict the winner of the 2025–26 NHL Stanley Cup championship.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Carolina Hurricanes hold an 80.5% implied probability as 2026 Stanley Cup champions primarily because they lead the Vegas Golden Knights 3-2 in the best-of-seven final following a 4-2 Game 5 victory on June 11. Carolina dominated the regular season with 113 points as Metropolitan Division and Eastern Conference leaders, then swept early playoff rounds before outlasting the Montreal Canadiens in the conference final. Their recent adjustments in special teams and goaltending have produced timely scoring, including multi-goal efforts from players like Jordan Staal. The Golden Knights, despite a strong Western Conference run that included a sweep of the Avalanche, have dropped three of five games in the series and now face elimination on the road or at home in a potential Game 7. Trader consensus reflects the narrow but decisive series advantage and Carolina’s superior depth and momentum heading into Game 6.

eventMetadata.context_description: The New York Knicks hold an 80.9% implied probability in the 2026 NBA champion market after surging to a 3-1 Finals lead over the San Antonio Spurs. Their commanding position stems from a record-setting 29-point comeback victory in Game 4 on June 10, powered by Jalen Brunson’s clutch playmaking, Karl-Anthony Towns’ interior dominance, and defensive contributions from OG Anunoby and Mikal Bridges that flipped a potential Spurs blowout. The Knicks’ regular-season resilience (53-29 record) and playoff pedigree, including multiple large rallies en route to the Eastern Conference title, underpin trader confidence in their ability to close out the series at home or on the road. The Spurs, despite Victor Wembanyama’s impact and an unexpected Western Conference run, saw their title odds crater after the Game 4 collapse, leaving them with limited paths to force a Game 7.

question: Will MegaETH perform an airdrop by June 30?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if MegaETH launches a token and performs an airdrop by June 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market "locked" tokens or non-swappable tokens will not suffice to resolve this market to "Yes". Airdrops of NFTs will not qualify.

The primary resolution source for this market is on-chain information and official information from MegaETH, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

question: Will Spain win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
description:
This market will resolve according to the national team that wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

If at any point it becomes impossible for this team to win the FIFA World Cup based on the rules of FIFA (e.g., they are eliminated in the knockout stage), this market will resolve immediately to “No”.

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup is permanently canceled or has not been completed by October 13, 2026, 11:59 PM this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from FIFA, however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Spain and France lead trader pricing as co-favorites entering the 2026 World Cup, driven by Spain’s Euro 2024 title and maturing core featuring Lamine Yamal alongside a balanced midfield, and France’s exceptional squad depth and resilience under Didier Deschamps. Portugal and England sit close behind on the strength of consistent recent results, star attacking talent, and deep benches suited to a grueling expanded tournament. Argentina’s back-to-back aspirations rest on Lionel Messi’s leadership and strong qualifying form, while Brazil’s traditional pedigree keeps it competitive despite recent inconsistencies. The tight spread among these sides and Germany, the Netherlands, and others reflects broad parity in rankings, head-to-head records, and squad quality across UEFA and CONMEBOL contenders, with limited separation in pre-tournament power rankings.
